caption: The drawing features a single, vertically oriented wooden object placed against a plain, light beige background. The object is rectangular with a symmetrical shape, but the top edges extend upward, forming two parallel prongs with a V-shaped notch between them. The wood displays a prominent grain pattern in shades of brown, with darker brown and black lines running lengthwise, simulating wood texture. There are four small, round pegs or nails visible near the notched top, aligned horizontally. A small, rectangular protrusion is visible on the left side of the object, approximately one-third from the top. The bottom of the object is more narrow, with slightly angled cuts at the lower edges. The drawing is signed "A. HAUGLAND" near the bottom right corner.
title: Bootjack
